gpt.text:
Run the three “Next Commands” in order; they form a complete loop: (1) search/select the best AUB module candidate, (2) run system-level candidates, (3) generate a prioritized “next fix” report based on results.

## 1) Run AUB autopilot (module-level) and select best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
What to watch for:
- It should update your “current champion” artifact (or create a new candidate/champion entry) based on whatever selection criteria your framework uses.
- After it finishes, confirm whether `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` changed or a new champion file was written (some setups version these).

## 2) Run system autopilot (system-level candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
What to watch for:
- Whether any system candidates beat the champion on your primary metric(s) (likely tuning/lockbox summaries).
- Any candidates marked PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE in the produced report/logs.

## 3) Generate “next fix” report
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
What to watch for:
- It should write `baseline/reports/next_fix.md` with actionable items (typically weakest modules, highest expected gain, flaky tests, missing eval coverage).

## Quick sanity checks after running
- Confirm the champion stats improved (or at least didn’t regress), especially:
  - `tuning_mean/min`
  - `lockbox_mean/min`
- Verify there are no new regressions in “min” metrics (often the guardrail).
- If anything comes back INCONCLUSIVE, re-run that specific candidate with a fixed seed / more trials (depending on your framework’s knobs).

If you paste the stdout (or the generated reports/updated champion JSON diff), I can help interpret which candidate actually won and what the next fix report is recommending.
